auth: 1. Register an application in the Commerce API Center (SELF or SELLER type) → client id + client secret.
2. Per call: timestamp (ms) → bcrypt(`{clientId}_{timestamp}`, salt = clientSecret) → base64 → client_secret_sign.
3. POST the token request; use the Bearer token on external/v1|v2 endpoints.

reason: Naver Commerce API (https://apicenter.commerce.naver.com/docs/auth, re-opened 2026-09-25): the only token grant is POST https://api.commerce.naver.com/external/v1/oauth2/token (client_credentials, type SELF/SELLER) with client_secret_sign = Base64(BCrypt.hashpw(client_id + "_" + <ms timestamp>, salt = client_secret)) and that same millisecond timestamp as a form field. Token requests can carry templated/signed fields (token_sign, token_body_extra) and JWT assertions (token_jwt), but their digests are HMAC, plain hash, RSA or JWT. Remaining runtime gap: bcrypt hashing (hashpw with the client_secret as the bcrypt salt) for the token request.
